title: Eventual compatibility of two prescribed local perfect models
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRingCat a system, c a colimit cocone, i an index, and t:Z → Spec R_i locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Fix shared derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Given j≥i, put Y_j=Z times_{R_i} R_j and X=Z times_{R_i} c.pt, and let g_j:X → Y_j be the canonical base-change map induced by c_j. Let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, A and B perfect complexes on U and V [def-pc-perfect-complex], and E any derived object on X. Suppose specified isomorphisms L(g_j|U)^*A ≅ E|_{g_j inverse U} and L(g_j|V)^*B ≅ E|_{g_j inverse V}, with canonical open restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Then there are k≥j and PerfectOpenGluingData(g_k,E) [def-pc-perfect-open-gluing-data], where g_k is the canonical map indexed by the composite i≤j≤k. No descent-on-opens hypothesis is assumed, and no global stage object is constructed.

source.place: Tag 09RF, construction of the adjoint maps a,b and descent of c, before Tag 08DG

proof.text: Obtain the geometric stage object and comparison morphism, with local perfectness and local invertibility witnesses. Apply perfect_of_open_pullbacks to obtain global perfectness and schemeDerived_isIso_of_openRestriction to obtain global invertibility. Turn the comparison into an isomorphism and construct the adjoint gluing data from the perfect object using the top open twice. Return the same stage and inequality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09RF, geometric gluing followed by adjunction

theorem perfect_local_models_eventually_compatible
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens)
    (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (hU : IsCompact (U : Set (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))) : Scheme.{u})))
    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))) : Scheme.{u})))
    (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
    (hA : U.toScheme.IsPerfect A) (hB : V.toScheme.IsPerfect B)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))))
    (φU : (derivedPullback ((baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))) ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction _ ((baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))) ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
    (φV : (derivedPullback ((baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))) ∣_ V)).obj B ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction _ ((baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let g := baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app k))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))]))
      PerfectOpenGluingData g E
